mapper.insert: insert into tb_campus_order (order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, goods_id, goods_title, price_fen, pay_type, status, pickup_point, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsTitle}, #{priceFen}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{pickupPoint}, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from tb_campus_order where goods_id = #{goodsId} and buyer_id = #{buyerId} and status in (0, 1)
